notes.title: Cybernetic Seduction – Season 2 Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
Hi!
All rewards, achievements, and the full Steam setup for Cybernetic Seduction – Season 2 are already complete. With the final content wrapped up, we’re now heading into the last stretch before release.

And I know many of you have been waiting for the exact date. So let’s not keep it a mystery any longer.

Cybernetic Seduction – Season 2 will release on:
October 30th, 2025. 

Mark your calendars and get ready.

Ahead of launch, there will also be a small patch for Season 1 to make the transition into Season 2 smoother and more convenient for everyone.

In the meantime, I’m focused on spreading the word and gathering more wishlists. Season 2 has already climbed into the top 3800 on Steam, which is a big milestone for me. I didn’t expect that, and I’m truly grateful to everyone who’s shown support. It means a lot to know so many of you are looking forward to what’s next.

Here are a few preview renders from the final episode of Season 2. You won’t find these on the store page. It’s just a little something extra for those of you keeping up with the journey.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Updated Release Date of Season 1!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
I'm absolutely thrilled to share exciting news with you all: I've officially set a launch date! 
Mark your calendars for the May 3, 2024, as 'Cybernetic Seduction - Season 1' will be making its grand entrance on Steam.

The anticipation is real, and I'm right there with you, counting down the days! There's still a month to go, but it's going to be a month filled with fine-tuning tens of extra render rewards and achievements.

I'm also super excited to give you a sneak peek at one of the main characters - Freya! 

https://i.ibb.co/XWskrXB/Freya-Intro-1-1-1.png

She's hot, mysterious, and let's just say she's got a bit of a wild side. She's an essential part of the story, and I can't wait for you to meet her.

Take care!
